newsitem.title: USA: Duke Realty invests $67.4 mln in properties.
newsitem.headline: Duke Realty invests $67.4 mln in properties.

text.p: Duke Realty Investments Inc said Tuesday it has made a $67.4 million net investment in properties in the Midwest, including an Illinois office property and industrial buildings in Ohio.
Duke said it expected to earn a 10.8 percent stabilized return on the investment. The total cost of the properties, excluding undeveloped land, was $102.5 million.
In addition, Duke has invested $8.4 million in undeveloped land, the real estate company said.

Including these investments, the company has announced $235.0 million of new developments and acquisitions so far this year, it said. It expects to achieve a stabilized annual return of 11.1 percent on the investments.

The latest investments brought Duke's 66 percent pre-leased development backlog to 5.6 million square feet, representing a budgeted investment of $226.0 million with an expected return of 11.5 percent upon stabilization, it said.
